name: Corcept Therapeutics
summary: The one-week pilot launched to 11 Corcept users on September 28. A new summary-recall feature ships October 7 and isn't retroactive, so Matt proposed a readiness review on October 15 and a go-live based on that review. Jordan hasn't replied yet.

updates.text: Jordan launched the pilot to 11 users; all confirmed with access. Loreli added Sep 29.

Four success measures agreed: adoption, time back, coaching quality and user confidence. Coaching quality is the priority, judged by VP Sales Tom Burke and the ASDs. Readouts at 2 weeks, 30 and 60 days.
Matt proposed a revised plan: time survey Oct 2, rubric approved Oct 8, summary workflow validated by Oct 13, joint readiness review Oct 15.
Jordan asked for a Harvi quick-start guide.
